The note argues the measurement pipeline: intelligibility 'is measured through acoustic analysis using signal processing techniques.' The pinned sense — 'pitch-synchronous is a specific type of vocoder' — misreads the entry. The accepted definition of pitch-synchronous makes it an alignment/framing METHOD: it centers analysis and synthesis windows on detected pitch periods. It is a component technique EMPLOYED BY many vocoder designs (PSOLA, WSOLA, pitch-synchronous code-excited vocoders) and by time-stretchers; it itself performs no analysis-into-parameters-then-resynthesis, which is the structure the accepted vocoder definition requires. A part or instrument of a kind's designs is not an instance of the kind (Law 9: X must be a specific KIND of Y). Direction aside, the kind claim itself fails. STRIKE.

As filed, the kind claim fails. STRIKE.

The note conflates two distinct quantities. Phase COHERENCE (per its definition) quantifies consistency of phase relationships across frequency components or over time WITHIN a signal; phase RESPONSE (per its accepted definition) is the angular shift phi(omega) a LINEAR SYSTEM imposes on signal components. Coherence estimation runs on the signal's own phase across frames and bins (or cross-spectra against a reference signal) — a system's phase response is not an input to it, so the stated removal consequence ('coherence cannot be computed') does not follow. And even where a metric's estimation pipeline consumes some data, that is a measurement dependency, not a constitutive one (Law 8b): the property does not stop being coherence when the estimator changes. STRIKE.

True kind-claim at the nearest rung. Specific to general (Law 9), and there is no intermediate kind between phase-vocoder and vocoder to leap over (Law 11e satisfied). ADVANCE.

STRIKE the leap to the discipline.

True kind-claim. Specific to general (Law 9). True kind-claim at the nearest rung. Specific to general (Law 9); no intermediate kind sits between a formant vocoder and vocoder (Law 11e satisfied). ADVANCE.

The entry names the phase of a periodic audio signal — the angular offset relative to a reference. Spectral coloration — the non-flat character of a magnitude spectrum — is a legitimate distinct concept: the spectral property that produces timbral color, carved with real parameters (envelope shape, resonant peaks/troughs, affected bandwidth, emphasis magnitude in dB) and a real persistence mechanism (measurable via FFT/STFT, persists in recorded audio and analysis toolchains). Distinct from timbre (the percept) and from spectral flatness (a single scalar metric): this is the distributional property itself. Follows the board's accepted pattern for signal properties (cf. phase-response). Not a duplicate. ADVANCE.

Transient smearing is a produced artifact — the temporal spreading of a sharp transient caused by the finite impulse response of made codec/filter stages — persisting in decoded audio output. The definition carves its parameters (original transient width, impulse-response duration, resulting width, amplitude loss) and its persistence (measurable waveform distortion, visible on displays). Not a duplicate. ADVANCE.

Speech enhancement is a real, persistent made body of practice — the discipline of algorithms (spectral subtraction, Wiener filtering, deep denoisers, dereverberation) that restore intelligibility and quality of degraded speech. The definition carves its parameters (degradation model, enhancement target, processing domain, estimator type) and persists through textbooks, standards, and production audio stacks. Made-side (a discipline/institution, Laws 1-3), distinct from speech-processing in general (this names the degradation-restoration purpose). ADVANCE.

Identity, not dependency. Coherence is computed from the signal's phase, not from a linear system's phase response; the two are different constructs. 'Without phase-response data coherence cannot be computed' confuses the signal's phase with the system's phase response. The edge as pinned does not hold.

A syllogism is a species of deductive reasoning — a three-term form (major premise, minor premise, conclusion). The filer's own note argues it "requires logic to validate its structure" and to "distinguish valid from invalid forms." That is a META-LEVEL claim: it is the discipline judging the form, not the form operating. Under Law 8b, losing the ability to validate or categorize a form is Law 2b's shadow and files no edge; only the collapse of X's own working counts. Remove the discipline of logic and the syllogism still OPERATES — a speaker still states the three terms and reasons by them; what is lost is the meta-criterion of validity, which is logic's judgment of the form, not the form's operation. Furthermore, under Law 8c a thing does not depend on what it IS: a syllogism IS a logical form, so "syllogism depends on logic" is identity mislabeled as dependency — the true relation is INSTANCE_OF (a syllogism is a kind of deductive reasoning; per Law 9/9a a form stands to its discipline as subject-matter or kind, never as a removal-test dependency). The pinned sense (a deductive form needing logical criteria to be judged valid) is exactly the sayable/categorize shadow. STRIKE.

Retroduction (Peircean inference to the best explanation) is a specific MODE of inference. The filer's note argues it "requires logic to evaluate competing hypotheses" and "loses its criteria for valid [inference]." That dependency is about the CRITERIA by which competing hypotheses are judged — a meta-level judgment, not the operation of the method itself. Under Law 8b, losing the discipline that supplies the validity criterion is Law 2b's shadow: it files no edge. Remove the discipline of logic and retroduction still OPERATES — a reasoner still observes evidence, generates candidate explanations, and selects the one that best fits; abductive reasoning as a practice predates and outlives formal logic. What the discipline provides is the meta-criterion of validity, not the working of the method. And per Law 8c, retroduction IS a form of inference — a kind of reasoning — so "retroduction depends on logic" is identity/kind mislabeled as dependency; the true relation is INSTANCE_OF (a species of inference), which Law 9/9a keeps out of the removal test. STRIKE.

Per its accepted definition, speech-intelligibility is a perceptual METRIC that "quantifies the degree to which speech can be understood by a listener," with parameters of listener population and test material (phonemes/words) — i.e., a behavioral measurement (present test material, score comprehension). The filer's note argues the metric is "grounded in how the auditory system processes sound." That describes the SUBSTRATE the metric maps — a perceptual phenomenon (Law 2a territory) — not an operational dependency. Under Law 8b the question is whether X stops OPERATING when Y is removed: remove the DISCIPLINE of psychoacoustics (the study of sound perception) and the metric still runs — word/phoneme-recognition tests and articulation indices are still administered and scored; the perceptual phenomenon it measures exists whether or not a named discipline studies it. What the discipline supplies is the explanatory framework (the why), which is the meta-level/grounding argument Law 2b says files no edge. This is the property/metric case: the map and its standard measurement survive the discipline. STRIKE.

mel-cepstral-distortion is an objective, human-made METRIC — a specific measurement instrument (per its definition, the RMS deviation of mel-cepstral coefficient vectors between a reference and a test utterance) for assessing perceived speech quality/difference. It is squarely on the made side (Law 1): a human-made measurement convention, referent THING, built to persist in audio-engineering literature and evaluation pipelines. The scope is a genuine "why it is human-made and built to persist," not boilerplate, and the name is a normalized construct distinct from its components (mel-cepstral coefficients, signal-processing) — not a duplicate. A clean, defensible made-thing entry. ADVANCE.

DEPENDS_ON requires operational dependency: removing Y must cause X to stop operating, not merely become unsayable. The note describes syllogism needing logic to validate its structure, which is a constitutive/conceptual relationship — syllogism is a form within logic, not an artifact whose operation halts if logic is removed. This is the classic Law 8b/2b misuse where conceptual necessity is asserted as operational dependency.

Retroduction as inference to best explanation is a mode of reasoning defined within logic; the note claims it needs logic to evaluate hypotheses, which is a constitutive conceptual dependency, not an operational one. Removing logic would not stop retroduction from operating as a practice — it would merely make it unclassifiable. Law 8b forbids DEPENDS_ON for 'sayable' dependencies.

Dialectic is a method of argumentation that is a form within logic; the note says removing logic removes its framework for distinguishing valid arguments. This is a definitional/constitutive relationship, not an operational dependency where dialectic would cease to operate. Law 8b requires remove-Y-now-X-stops-operating, not remove conceptual classification.

Formant-vocoder is a specific implementation/type of vocoder, not an artifact built to serve the broader class vocoder. The note claims it serves the broader class by providing a particular approach, which reverses the taxonomy: a specific kind does not serve its genus, it instantiates it. The correct relation would be INSTANCE_OF, not SERVES. Law 8d requires servant points at master for whose sake it was built.

Merge conflict is an artifact that arises from version control operations, not an artifact built for the sake of version control. SERVES requires an intentional servant built for a master’s purpose. A conflict is a side-effect / failure mode, not a designed servant. The relation confuses emergence with purpose.

Butterworth filter is a specific kind of filter, itself a signal-processing technique. Removing the general category 'signal-processing' would remove the filter itself, not leave a filter that fails to operate. Law 8b prohibits DEPENDS_ON for mere 'is a type of' or definitional inclusion.

Law 10 whole-and-part, pinned sense. Language's accepted definition carves its parameters as lexicon, syntax, semantics; grammar's accepted definition carves 'the system of rules and patterns that govern the structure and combination of elements WITHIN a language' (phonemes into morphemes into words into clauses). Grammar is a component system inside the whole of language — a part, as an engine is a part of a car — not a kind of language (no competent speaker calls grammar 'a language', so the alternative INSTANCE_OF framing fails the Law 9 test). The note pins this part-whole sense and cites the target's own accepted definition. ADVANCE.

Fails the Law 9/9a kind-of test: would a competent speaker call grammar 'a language'? No. Language's accepted definition carves a system of symbolic signs structured for encoding/transmitting/decoding meaning, with parameters lexicon, syntax, semantics; grammar's own accepted definition carves the rule system governing elements WITHIN a language — a component of the whole, not a member of the class. The filer's own note concedes this: 'constitutes part of language' is Law 10's part-whole language, and the correctly-shaped relation is language CONTAINS grammar (pending separately). A thing's internal rule system is never an instance of the thing it governs. STRIKE.

Law 11d: judge the pinned sense against the target's accepted definition. The live accepted definition of 'information' carves SHANNON INFORMATION THEORY — 'a mathematical framework for quantifying, storing, and communicating information, founded by Claude Shannon in 1948', parameters entropy and mutual information. A rumour (an unverified social claim in circulation) is not an instance of that construct; no competent speaker would say a rumour is 'a Shannon information-theoretic quantity'. The filer's note pins the generic content sense ('unverified information transmitted informally'), which is a DIFFERENT sense of the word — answering a different question, not refuting the claim. Under the target's pinned definition the edge is false. STRIKE.

Law 8b removal test at the object level. Rumour's accepted definition carves 'the transmission of unverified information across a social network', with the parameter that it 'spreads through interpersonal channels'. Communication is the process of transmitting information between parties. Remove communication and a rumour cannot travel — it collapses to a private belief; the social phenomenon stops OPERATING. This is not the Law 2b meta-shadow (not 'a rumour as a concept needs language' — that would be true of every entry): the note names the mechanism of the rumour's own spread, its substrate. Nor is it identity under Law 8c: a rumour is the PATTERN of unverified claims in circulation, while communication is the transmission process carrying it; pattern and process are distinct, and the pattern dies without the process. ADVANCE.

Law 9 kind-of test, pinned sense. Syllogism's own accepted definition carves it as 'a form of deductive reasoning in which a conclusion is derived from two premises... three propositions, three terms' — a specific, named form. Deductive-reasoning's accepted definition lists its parameters as '(2) a rule of inference (e.g. modus ponens, syllogism)' — the target's definition names the source as one of its forms. A competent speaker would say a syllogism IS a deductive-argument form. Nearest kind: syllogism carries no accepted INSTANCE_OF edge, so this is a first true connection, not a derivable leap (Law 11e door is open). ADVANCE.

Law 8b removal test at the object level. Remove signal-processing (the discipline of analyzing/transforming signals) and the coefficients cannot be computed — the metric stops OPERATING, it does not merely stop being sayable. This is the method-whose-pipeline-is-the-discipline shape, not the property-whose-standard-measurement shape: MCD is the computation, and spectral/mel analysis is its own mechanism, not a contingent instrument. ADVANCE.

Law 8b removal test at the object level. MCD's accepted definition carves it as quantifying perceptual difference by 'computing the RMS deviation of their mel-cepstral coefficient vectors in the mel-frequency domain' — the mel filterbank, log power spectrum, and cepstral transform are spectral-analysis operations: decomposition of the signal into frequency components followed by a spectral-domain transform. Remove spectral-analysis and the coefficients cannot be computed; the metric stops OPERATING, not merely stop being sayable. The note pins exactly this mechanism. Law 8d for-whose-sake. Cherry-pick is a git SCM operation (pinned sense confirmed: git operation, not the rhetorical sense). For whose sake is it built? Grammar is not a specific kind of language; it is a rule system within language. The note itself says grammar constitutes part of language, which is CONTAINS, not INSTANCE_OF. A rumour's operation is propagation through informal channels. Remove communication and the rumour cannot move from person to person, so it stops operating as a rumour. This is object-level dependency, not meta-level sayability. Law 8 removal test is satisfied.

Syllogism is a specific form of deductive reasoning, a structured argument where conclusions follow necessarily from premises. A competent speaker would call a syllogism a kind of deductive reasoning. Direction specific to general is correct.

Definition carves cherry-pick as a human-made version-control operation selecting and applying specific commits without merging the entire branch. Identity, not dependency (Law 8c): a syllogism IS a form of deduction — the correct relation is the INSTANCE_OF edge already filed for this pair. The syllogism's inferential force comes from its own valid three-term form, not from an external deduction mechanism; the note's 'premises evaluated through deductive inference' is circular because that inference IS the syllogism. The formant vocoder's constitutive pipeline is spectral analysis + linear prediction + DSP resynthesis — none of which IS the target. speech-processing is accepted as a DISCIPLINE: remove the discipline and the algorithms still run (Law 8b — conceptual/field dependency, not operational). Read as the activity instead, the vocoder is PART of that practice — a CONTAINS relation, not a DEPENDS_ON (Law 8c: constitution/part-of is not dependency). Law 11e: the nearest kind is already established — syllogism INSTANCE_OF->deductive-reasoning is ACCEPTED, and the syllogism's own accepted definition pins it as 'a form of deductive reasoning' (deductive-reasoning's def even cites the syllogism as its example rule). Law 8b: conjecture's accepted definition is an EPISTEMIC POSTURE — a proposition held provisionally true without full justification, used to explore consequences. The target 'logic' is a FORMAL system of valid inference rules. Remove formal logic and conjecturing continues unchanged — conjectures predate and operate outside formal systems; holding a proposition as provisional needs no inference rules or symbolic notation. The note's 'needs logic as its operating framework' is the every-entry conceptual dependency ('as a concept it needs logic'), which files nothing.

The target logic is accepted as 'a formal system of VALID inference rules' — but retroduction (abduction) is constitutively NON-valid: it is the ampliative leap from a surprising fact to a best-explanation hypothesis, its force is plausibility, not truth-preservation. The mechanism the note claims logic provides ('selecting between competing explanations') is exactly what logic-as-valid-rules does NOT cover. Remove formal logic and retroduction operates exactly as before. The accepted ladder already places it correctly: retroduction INSTANCE_OF->abduction->inference (both ACCEPTED).

Constitutive: MTC's accepted definition makes its parameters the test statistics, significance thresholds, and FWER/FDR targets — all quantities of the statistics corpus (accepted def: 'formal language of probability and distribution' + 'standards for measuring and reporting uncertainty'). Remove that corpus and there is no significance threshold to adjust and no error-rate target to control — Bonferroni (alpha/m) and Benjamini-Hochberg (ordered p-values vs i*q/m) are written in that language. Unlike a discipline target, statistics is defined as an operative corpus of methods, and the note pins the sense the target's definition carries (p-values, error rates). Direction correct.

Law 8d/11d: the curse's accepted definition names its force-giving framework as 'religious, magical, OR social' — religion is one of three possible frameworks, not the master for whose sake the speech act exists. The curse's purpose (per its def) is invoking harm on a target; religion is a context some curses use, not the sake of the concept. The note pins 'built and maintained within religious and ritual contexts for the sake of religious practice', a sense the target-side definition contradicts (magical and social curses stand without religion). A SERVES arrow must point at the concept's master; here it points at one of three optional frameworks.

Law 8b: psychoacoustics is accepted as a SCIENTIFIC DISCIPLINE that builds models of auditory perception — a field of study, not an operational substrate. Speech intelligibility is measured behaviorally (listener word/phoneme recognition scores, articulation/STI indices); the phenomenon rests on human auditory perception, a natural process — not on the discipline that studies it. Remove the discipline and behavioral intelligibility testing operates unchanged (it predates psychoacoustic modeling). Model-based intelligibility measures do draw on critical-band theory, but that is the metric's optional modeling layer, not the concept's constitutive dependency.

Law 6: the first definition of spectral-coloration ends without the display trailer — the body stops at '...persists through measurement algorithms and standardized spectral metrics' with no [formal: ...] trailer. Law 6: first definition of transient-smearing ends without the display trailer — body stops at '...interaural cross-correlation degradation and transient preservation metrics' with no [formal: ...] trailer. Properly carves spectral-coloration: the non-flat character of a frequency spectrum (bands emphasized/attenuated, timbral quality). Parameters: spectral envelope shape, resonant peaks/troughs, affected bandwidth, magnitude in dB. Persistence: measurable via FFT/STFT, persists in recorded audio as characteristic timbre. Law 6 trailer present and well-formed.

Properly carves speech-enhancement: algorithms improving intelligibility/perceived quality of speech degraded by noise, reverberation, distortion. Five real parameters (degradation model, target, domain, estimator type, latency). Persistence: DSP modules in telephony, hearing aids, voice assistants, codecs; PESQ/STOI standards. Trailer present.

Properly carves mask-based-enhancement: estimating a time-frequency mask to attenuate noise while preserving speech. Five parameters (mask type, estimator, T-F representation, threshold/sparsity, application rule incl. magnitude multiplication with phase preservation). Persistence: research literature, telecom standards, hearing-aid firmware, libraries. Trailer present.

Properly carves storage: a system retaining retrievable information by encoding in a durable substrate. Properly carves rebase: rewriting a branch's commit history to replay on another branch's tip. Parameters: source branch, target base, per-commit conflict resolutions, authorship flags. Properly carves speech-intelligibility: a perceptual metric of how well speech is understood. Parameters: listener population/hearing, test material, presentation condition (SNR, reverb, distortion), scoring method. Mechanism: controlled listening tests + SII-style acoustic prediction; persists through standardized test protocols, speech-science literature, hearing-aid/telecom standards. Trailer present.

Properly carves audio-phase: angular offset of a periodic waveform vs a reference, in [0, 2π). Parameters: phase angle, reference (signal or t=0), frequency (phase advance 2πf), domain (waveform vs complex FFT coefficient). Persistence: stored as parameter in DSP software, phase meters/oscilloscope X-Y, complex bins (atan2). Closes with the state-variable note (alignment + interference). Trailer present.

Properly carves pull-request: an artifact proposing changes to a shared codebase for review and integration. Six parameters (source branch, target branch, diff set, authorship, review status/comments, merge decision). Persistence: metadata + linked commits in the VCS, repository history, review records, CI/CD audit trails. Trailer present.

Properly carves ordinal: ordered categories where rank is meaningful but intervals not necessarily equal. Properly carves input-validation: checking/filtering/transforming external input against constraints before processing. Accepted def of syllogism says verbatim 'a form of deductive reasoning'; deduction's accepted def is 'the human-made form of reasoning in which a conclusion follows necessarily from premises'. Law 9: 'X is a specific kind of Y' is ALWAYS INSTANCE_OF — the note's competent-speaker test passes ('a form of deduction'), and deduction is the NEAREST kind: the definition names it directly, no intermediate rung exists or is needed. Law 8c: identity is not dependency. The accepted syllogism definition already says it IS a form of deductive reasoning — the relation to deduction is kind, not dependency. The note's removal argument ('premises are evaluated through deductive inference') just re-describes what a syllogism is; it shows no consequence of removing deduction on a separate operation, because there is no separate operation. The correct edge is INSTANCE_OF, which is filed separately (ga79c7e379964122ba3926b14). The DEPENDS_ON filing is the same relation misfiled.

Object-level removal test passes (Laws 8/8b). A merge-conflict is the artifact a version-control merge operation produces: its definition names 'two versions of a file' (versions are a VC construct), 'cannot be automatically reconciled' (auto-merge is a VC operation), and persists as conflict markers in VC working copies logged in merge-request history. Remove version-control — no branches, no versions, no merge operation — and the artifact cannot arise or persist. Not meta (not merely sayable) and not identity (the conflict is what the framework PRODUCES, not what it is). Note runs the test correctly.

Laws 8b/8c. speech-processing's accepted definition is a DISCIPLINE ('a human-made signal-processing discipline that transforms, analyzes, or synthesizes human speech signals'). The note's 'pipeline for spectral analysis, form extraction, and parameter estimation' IS the formant vocoder's own operation — the removal argument is circular: it removes the thing the vocoder itself does. A technique within a discipline is a kind-of relation (INSTANCE_OF, if any), not a dependency; identity is not dependency (8c), and the note never shows the vocoder's working collapse from the absence of the discipline — it only re-describes the vocoder. A phase/formant vocoder also operates on non-speech signals, so the 'speech' in the discipline is not load-bearing for its operation.

Wiener filter's defining computation H(f)=S_x(f)/(S_x(f)+S_n(f)) consumes power spectral densities - the canonical outputs of spectral analysis (per that entry's accepted def: 'spectral density' extracted via transform). Remove spectral analysis, the filter has no spectral input representation and its frequency-dependent gain cannot be computed. Object-level removal test passes for the pinned sense (8b/11d); not identity, not meta.

The note's 'frame-based analysis, phase estimation, synthesis pipeline' is the vocoder's own operation - identity, not dependency (8c). The accepted def shows the substrate is STFT frames - a spectral-analysis technique - used for time-stretching and pitch-shifting of ANY audio, not speech. Removing the speech-processing discipline stops nothing: the algorithm keeps operating. Consistent with my ruling on formant-vocoder->speech-processing.

The accepted def defines formants as 'the resonant peaks of the speech spectrum' and names formant detection (e.g. linear prediction) as the operating parameter. Formant tracking IS spectral estimation: remove the practice of spectral analysis and there is no spectrum from which to extract formant frequencies - the vocoder's analysis stage stops operating. Object-level removal test passes (8b); the spectrum is the input representation, not a meta-framework.

The accepted def makes a conjecture a pre-inferential epistemic posture: 'held as provisionally true WITHOUT full justification'. The quantities a conjecture manipulates are propositions - that is language, not logic.

The entry names a MAP: the metric of how well speech is understood, not the listener's comprehension itself (territory). The entry names a measurable signal-processing property: consistency of phase relationships, quantified by a defined coherence metric. Clean Law 4 carve: what it is (incompatible divergence of two file versions, not auto-reconcilable), five parameters (both change sets, conflict markers, path/line range, resolution status), and a real persistence mechanism (working copies, merge-request history, repository state, CI logs, code review records) plus trailer. Parameters (coherence metric, analysis window/hop, reference signal, threshold) plus persistence (DSP textbooks, analysis libraries, measurement instruments, re-instantiation per analysis/synthesis task) and trailer. Parameters (original width, IR duration, resulting width, amplitude loss) are the right ones; persistence through measurable waveform distortion in recorded/simulated audio, observable on waveform displays - a behavioral substrate the effect re-instantiates in every filtered signal. Carves, distinguishes, persists.

A curse's own sake is not religion. A curse is an imprecatory speech act whose designed purpose is to invoke harm or misfortune or to express hostility, and it operates fully in secular contexts (threats, imprecations, casual damnations) where no religion is present. 'Built and maintained within religious and ritual contexts' is an association of common habitat, not teleology: Law 8d asks for whose sake the servant is built, and the curse is built for harm/imprecation, not for the sake of religious practice. Remove religion and curses still operate; religious curses are a context in which curses appear, not a master they serve. STRIKE.

Speech intelligibility is a property/measure of how well spoken language is understood, whose STANDARD MEASUREMENT uses the discipline of psychoacoustics. That is the map's shadow (Law 2b), not the property's own working: remove psychoacoustics and intelligibility does not stop operating - listeners still understand speech, and intelligibility is still measured by word-recognition scores and other means. The map survives; measurement continues by other means (the established STRIKE shape for a property whose standard measurement uses a discipline). 'Intelligibility is fundamentally perceptual' recites the territory's mechanics, not a removal of the construct's operation. STRIKE.

The filer's own note defines a syllogism AS 'a deductive reasoning form' - a thing does not depend on what it IS (Law 8c: identity is not dependency; the knowledge-bases→memory case). A syllogism is a specific kind of deductive argument - a competent speaker calls a syllogism 'a deduction' - so the honest relation is INSTANCE_OF (Law 9), or topic-to-field if deduction were treated as a discipline. As filed, the DEPENDS_ON argues 'premisses are evaluated through deductive inference; without deduction the syllogism cannot conclude' - a constitutive assertion of identity: removing 'deduction' removes the syllogism because the syllogism IS a deduction, not because it needs it running to operate. STRIKE.

Changed on argument. Logic's accepted definition carves it as a formal system of VALID inference rules - and retroduction (abduction) is constitutively NON-valid: it is the ampliative mode that operates OUTSIDE valid inference, by hypothesis generation and explanatory-fit assessment ('a matter of course'), not by applying valid rules. Remove the formal system of valid inference rules and abduction does not stop operating - if anything it is the inference mode least constrained by them. My ADVANCE argued for a broader discipline-sense of logic than the target's accepted definition carves, which is the Law 11d error: answering a different question. The removal test fails at the object level under the accepted carve. STRIKE.

The Wiener filter's defining computation is spectral: its optimal gain is a frequency-domain ratio of signal and noise power spectra (H(f) = Sxx/(Sxx+Snn)), and its input representation is the spectral data of the signal. Removing spectral analysis removes the representation on which the filter computes its frequency-dependent gain - the method's own pipeline stops, which the note shows as a removal consequence rather than a bare 'constitutive' assertion. This is the method's operating substrate (the method whose pipeline IS the discipline's method), not the meta-level sayability shadow of Law 2b. ADVANCE.

Changed on argument. The note's 'frame-based analysis, phase estimation, and synthesis pipeline' is the vocoder's OWN operation - and speech-processing (accepted: a signal-processing discipline, referent CONCEPT) is the broad discipline that CONTAINS the vocoder as one of its methods. Removing the discipline removes the method as a MEMBER, not because the method's operation fails: that is membership, not dependency (Law 8c shape - a thing does not need the class it belongs to; the honest edge here is INSTANCE_OF, a phase-locked vocoder is a kind of speech-processing technique). The refined distinction: a method DEPENDS_ON a specific substrate method it consumes (Wiener filter consumes spectral representations - that edge stands), but a method does not DEPEND_ON the broad discipline it is a member of. STRIKE.

A formant vocoder is built for the sake of modeling and synthesizing speech via its formant parameters (speech synthesis and phonetic analysis), not for the sake of speech enhancement. Enhancement (intelligibility improvement) is one downstream application among many - the note itself lists 'voice conversion', which is not enhancement, revealing that the filing conflates applications with purpose. Law 8d asks for whose sake the servant is built by design: the formant vocoder's designed purpose is speech modeling/synthesis. Remove speech-enhancement and the formant vocoder still operates fully (synthesis, research, conversion). Application is not master. STRIKE.

Formant extraction operates on speech spectra: formants are resonance peaks in the spectral envelope, and the vocoder's first pipeline stage computes per-frame formant frequencies, bandwidths, and excitation parameters FROM the speech spectrum. Removing spectral analysis removes the input representation on which formant tracking operates - the method's own pipeline stops at its first stage. This is the method-whose-pipeline-is-the-discipline's-methods shape (object-level removal consequence shown in the note), not the meta-level shadow of Law 2b. ADVANCE.

Pinned sense: a merge-conflict is the artifact that arises when version-control detects incompatible divergences in a file's history and cannot auto-reconcile them. The artifact is PRODUCED by the system's merge operation - it is not the system (so not identity under Law 8c), and removing version-control removes the history tracking and merge operation that generate the artifact, so the artifact stops arising. The note argues the removal's consequence at the object level, not by chronology (Law 8a) and not by the sayability shadow (Law 2b). ADVANCE.

The formant vocoder's pipeline IS the methods of the discipline of speech processing: per-frame speech spectral analysis, formant extraction, and parameter estimation, then synthesis. Remove speech-processing and those pipeline stages are removed, so the vocoder cannot operate. This is the method-whose-pipeline-is-the-discipline's-methods shape passing the Law 8 object-level removal test, not the meta-level nameability shadow of Law 2b. ADVANCE.

Pinned sense: conjecture as the ACTIVITY of forming a tentative explanation for further investigation. Forming a conjecture is an inferential act - proposing a hypothesis from data, formulating it as a proposition, and evaluating its consistency - and the operating norms for all of those moves are the content of the discipline of logic. Remove logic (the body of principles of propositions and inference) and the activity loses its operating framework: it cannot formulate propositions or evaluate consistency, so it stops operating. This is the method's own working (the inferential mechanism), not the meta-level sayability shadow of Law 2b - the same object-level shape as retroduction→logic. ADVANCE.

A syllogism is a specific form of deductive reasoning - a deductive argument structured from two or more premises to a conclusion. A competent speaker would call a syllogism 'a deduction' / 'a deductive argument', so the Law 9 test (is X a specific kind of Y) passes. This is the honest relation where the DEPENDS_ON version failed on identity (Law 8c): the edge now points specific→general, and 'deduction' is the nearest kind - no closer rung (e.g. 'deductive-argument') stands between them in the accepted record, so no Law 11e ladder refusal. ADVANCE.

Multiple testing correction is a family of methods (Bonferroni, Holm, Benjamini-Hochberg FDR) whose operation IS statistical theory: adjusting significance thresholds and p-values under multiple simultaneous tests, controlling family-wise error and false discovery rate. Remove statistics - the theory of p-values, error rates, and significance - and the corrections have nothing to compute: the adjustment formulas are statistical theory instantiated. This is a method operating on the discipline's theory (object-level removal consequence), not a property whose standard measurement merely uses the discipline (which would be the STRIKE shape). ADVANCE.

Butterworth filter is a general-purpose IIR filter design criterion invented in 1930 for maximally flat passband in any application. It was not built for speech enhancement specifically, and its purpose is general frequency shaping. SERVES requires X be built/maintained for the sake of Y; using a general filter in a speech pipeline is use, not purpose. The edge misattributes purpose.

Mel-cepstral distortion is a perceptual metric explicitly designed to evaluate speech recognition system output. The note pins its design purpose: 'quantify distance between reference and processed speech, used specifically to evaluate and guide speech recognition systems.' SERVES is the correct relation here — the metric exists for the sake of speech recognition evaluation. The filer pins a clear purpose, not a dependency.

This fails the removal test (Law 8) and violates Law 8b. 'Inference' is a meta-level concept shared by every entry in the kingdom — retroduction, abduction, deduction, and conjecture all use inference. But that's not a constitutive dependency: it's the shadow the map casts on every wall (Law 2b). The note argues 'without the capacity for inference, retroduction as a reasoning process cannot operate' — but that's true of all reasoning methods. It shows they are sayable, not that retroduction stops OPERATING without inference as a specific mechanism. My previous rejection of syllogism→logic (rejected) followed the same pattern.

Falsifiability is a criterion that functions within the framework of hypothesis testing. Without the scientific method — the structured process of proposing hypotheses, designing tests, and evaluating outcomes — falsifiability cannot serve its role as a demarcation criterion. The removal test passes: remove scientific method and falsifiability as a criterion ceases to operate, because there is no testing framework for it to evaluate against.

Epistemology is a broad academic discipline, not an operational mechanism. Law 8b requires the removal test to ask: does X stop OPERATING, not just stop being framed within a discipline? Falsifiability as a criterion doesn't stop working because epistemology doesn't exist — it was used as a demarcation tool independently of formal epistemology. This is the same error as falsifiability→science or formalism→mathematics: confusing a domain or field with a constitutive mechanism.

Mathematics is the domain of formalism, not its operating mechanism. The removal test: if you remove mathematics, does formalism stop OPERATING? No — formalism as a philosophical position about the nature of mathematical truth still stands and functions. It loses its subject matter, but that is not the same as ceasing to operate. Law 8 says 'remove Y — does X stop working?'; removing the subject matter is not removing the mechanism. This is a domain/dependency confusion.

Butterworth filter is a general-purpose filter design used across many domains: audio engineering, instrumentation, control systems, RF design, etc. Speech enhancement is one application, not its designed purpose. Law 8d: SERVES means the designed purpose is to further the target's operation. The Butterworth design's purpose is maximally flat frequency response — it serves whatever system needs that response. Claiming it serves only speech enhancement is too narrow and not the design intent.

Formalism is a philosophy of mathematics, not a kind of logic. The note says it 'treats mathematical systems as formal symbolic manipulations governed by rules' — that describes a philosophical stance about mathematics, not a logical methodology. Law 9a: a topic is not an instance of its discipline. Formalism's subject matter is mathematics; its approach is philosophical.

The definition properly carves falsifiability: it identifies the concept (epistemological criterion for demarcation), specifies its parameter (existence of at least one conceivable observation that could count against the theory), and explains how it persists (as a standard used in scientific practice and philosophy). The trailer is present. This is a well-formed definition.

Definition properly carves butterworth-filter: identifies parameters (filter order N determining rolloff steepness), specifies persistence mechanism (analog circuit design / digital implementation), and includes the display trailer. The definition is specific enough to distinguish from other filter types (Chebyshev, Elliptic, Bessel).

Definition properly carves formalism: identifies parameters (formal symbols, explicit manipulation rules), specifies the key distinguishing feature (independence from semantic interpretation), and includes the display trailer. The definition is specific enough to distinguish formalism from other philosophy of mathematics approaches (platonism, intuitionism).

Direction fails the Law 8 removal test as pinned. Falsification's accepted sense is the epistemic PRACTICE of attempting to prove a hypothesis wrong: its parameters (hypothesis, contradictory observation, decision rule) are internal to the practice itself. Remove the scientific-method's institutionalized procedure and the practice does not stop OPERATING — one can still attempt to disprove a claim and act on the contradictory result outside any institutional framework; the accepted def locates only its PERSISTENCE (peer review, design norms) in the method, and Law 8b says persistence/sayability files no edge. If anything the direction is reversed: the scientific method's own accepted def distinguishes itself by its COMMITMENT to falsifiability — the method leans on the practice, not vice versa. The note asserts 'requires the framework' without showing the removal's consequence — a constitutiveness verdict without the test (Law 8b). STRIKE.

Kind claim fails against the pinned sense (Law 9, 11d). The target 'criterion' is accepted as a STANDARD or decision rule applied to instances. The source 'falsification' is accepted as the epistemic PRACTICE of attempting to prove a hypothesis wrong — an activity with a hypothesis, an experiment, and a decision rule, not a statable standard applied to instances. The note's argument ('it provides a standard: can the claim be shown false?') actually describes FALSIFIABILITY — the property/criterion — which the kingdom already carries as its own separate entry. A competent speaker says 'falsification is a method/practice' and 'falsifiability is a criterion'; they do not say 'falsification is a criterion.' The edge conflates the practice with its associated property. STRIKE.

The pinned sense passes the Law 9 kind test. The note fixes formalism as a philosophy of mathematics — the position (Hilbert's formalism, alongside logicism and intuitionism) that mathematics is rule-governed symbol manipulation independent of interpretation. That is a school/position within philosophy, and the accepted definition of 'philosophy' explicitly includes schools of thought in its institutional framework; a competent speaker calls formalism 'a philosophy' in this sense (as one calls logicism or intuitionism a philosophy of mathematics). No nearer rung exists in the graph (no philosophy-of-mathematics, school-of-thought, or similar entry), so philosophy is the nearest available kind (Law 11e door clear). The topic-vs-discipline warning of Law 9a does not apply: formalism is a position TAKEN within the discipline, not merely a subject it studies. ADVANCE.

The pinned sense is not the kind the target carves (Law 11d: judge the pinned sense against the accepted def; Law 9 kind test). 'process' is accepted as a HUMAN-MADE sequence of ordered actions DESIGNED to transform inputs into outputs through a repeatable, traceable flow, persisting through documentation — runbooks, protocols, SOPs, algorithms — with the distinguishing mark that anyone following the documented steps reproduces the output. The note pins conceptualization as a 'cognitive/epistemic process' — the accepted def of conceptualization says exactly that: a cognitive process forming mental categories from experience, persisting through language and teaching, not documentation. A cognitive process is not a designed, documented, repeatable procedure; the broad everyday sense of 'process' (any unfolding) is wider than this entry's carved sense, and the edge rides on that width. No nearer rung was available (no cognitive-process entry), which is why the leap was admitted at the door — but kindhood against the carved target still fails. STRIKE.

Law 8d 'for whose sake?' is misattributed. Remove the DISCIPLINE of signal processing (a body of practice, not an operational component) and the filter still operates; what the discipline gives is a design and analysis context, which is the sayable side of Law 8b's line, not the operating side. Same ruling as my Sept 2 line on discipline-identity deps (L8c). STRIKE.

Law 2b: 'X, as a concept, needs abstraction / categorization / cognition' is true of every entry in the kingdom and files nothing. Law 8 removal test fails. A minimum-phase filter is a kind of filter — an artifact with a defining mathematical property (zeros inside the unit circle; phase is the Hilbert transform of log magnitude) — not a method pipeline that IS the discipline's methods. Remove signal processing as a discipline and the filter still operates: it still maps input to output, its defining property still holds. What is lost is the framework that analyzes and designs it — the map, not the operation (Law 8b). The note's 'operating domain' argument is circular: a filter processes signals, so it sits inside signal processing, but membership in a domain is not dependency. Its genuine dependencies are specific mathematical instruments (the Fourier/z-transform, filed separately with a real removal test), not the whole discipline. Discipline-level DEPENDS_ON files nothing.

Law 7 which-came-first holds: statistics (the corpus of methods for reasoning under uncertainty — sampling, estimation, likelihood) is centuries older and historically fed into model averaging. Y existed first and fed into X — exactly DERIVED_FROM, correctly directed (statistics as source, model-averaging as descendant). The note argues by real chronology, not by present-tense need, so this is not a misused DEPENDS_ON.

Not identity: an ensemble is a construction paradigm that produces a model, it is not itself a model (Law 8c). Not purpose: models are its building material, not its client. This is a genuine present-tense operating dependency on the general model entry, whose accepted sense is the human-made abstraction.

Law 8d fails on both prongs. AIC (1973) predates formalized model averaging (1990s) by three decades: a servant cannot be built for the sake of a master that did not yet exist. Akaike weights are a later application of AIC, one client among many (selection, comparison, prediction) — incidental benefit, not the by-design purpose Law 8d requires. The note's own 'in this context' concedes it pins a single application as if it were the teleology. The defensible master would be model-selection, not model-averaging. As filed, this is not a SERVES claim.

log-likelihood does not DEPEND_ON kl divergence to operate. Log-likelihood = log P(data|model) — it computes from a likelihood function alone. Sense mismatch against the source's own accepted definition (Law 11d). Removal test fails (Laws 8a/8b). Log-likelihood is the natural log of the likelihood function — the product of a model's densities/PMFs evaluated at the observed data. Remove KL divergence from the world: log-likelihood computes identically, unchanged. The note concedes the real dependency ('log-likelihood computation requires the likelihood function which depends on probability distributions') and then mis-routes it to KL as 'the canonical divergence that log-likelihood evaluates' — but log-likelihood does not evaluate KL divergence; it point-evaluates a density at the data. Wrong target: the coherent dependency here, if any, points at likelihood-function or probability-distribution, not kl-divergence.

The target 'entropy' on this board is the GENERAL family entry: 'a human-made mathematical measure of uncertainty, randomness, or information content within a probability distribution' — spanning information theory, thermodynamics, statistical mechanics, ML. There is no separate shannon-entropy entry, so 'entropy itself' is correctly the nearest kind. Differential entropy h(X) = -∫ f·log f is the specific member of that family for continuous densities — a specific kind of the general measure, not a leap past an intermediate rung. Pinned sense ('the specific instance applied to continuous distributions rather than discrete') matches the carved sense of both definitions: discrete sum vs density integral, same log-probability measure. Specific-to-general (Law 9) holds.

Pinned sense runs through a skipped rung. The note's own operative argument is 'computed from a power spectrum; remove spectral analysis and the measure has no SPECTRUM to evaluate' — the dependency is on the power spectrum, and the board has an accepted power-spectrum entry (Wiener-Khinchin / |X(f)|^2 carve). Spectral analysis is the producer practice of that input, not the input itself. Filing the dependency at the practice level is a leap derivable through the direct-input rung (power-spectrum), which exists and is the coherent target. The note pins a spectrum-level sense but files a practice-level edge (Law 11d: judges judge the pinned sense — and the pinned sense points at power-spectrum, not spectral-analysis).

Same process under two names, not a kind-relation (Law 9). The accepted definition of retroduction: 'a structured mode of inference in which a reasoner moves from an observed surprising or anomalous fact to a hypothesized explanation that, if true, would render that fact expected' — that is Peirce's name for the abductive move. The accepted definition of abductive-reasoning: 'inference to the best explanation: generating a hypothesis that, if true, would account for an observed phenomenon.' Both carve the same inference (surprising fact → explanatory hypothesis); retroduction is the historical label for (a core phase of) abduction, not a specific member of a general abductive class. If retroduction is a phase (hypothesis generation within the full generate-and-select process), the relation is part-of, not kind-of; if it is the process, it is a synonym (Law 39 label material), not an instance. 'A named historical FORM of abductive reasoning' is the pinned sense, and a name-for is not a form-of.

Which-came-first (Law 7) holds. The normal distribution (Gauss, late 18th/early 19th c.) precedes the probit model (Bliss, 1934) and directly fed its construction: the probit link is the standard normal CDF itself — P(y=1|x) = Φ(Xβ) per the entry's own accepted definition — and the 'probit' (probability-unit) transform is the quantile of the normal. The note's pinned sense ('formulated using the CDF of the standard normal as its link function; direct derivation from normal distribution theory') matches the carved definition and the historical record. Chronological feeding, not present-tense necessity — DERIVED_FROM is the correct type.

Orthodoxy is not itself a belief; it is conformity to established doctrine or correct belief. A belief is an individual mental assent to a proposition; orthodoxy is a quality of alignment between a belief/doctrine and an accepted standard. The nearest kind for orthodoxy would be 'doctrine' or 'correctness-standard', not 'belief'.

Stipulation is indeed a specific kind of provision (term/condition set by authority in an agreement). A competent speaker would say a stipulation is a type of provision — one imposed by authority rather than negotiated. The sense is pinned correctly.

A statistical estimator is correctly described as a human-made rule of statistical inference mapping observed data to an estimate of an unknown quantity. The scope is clear and carveable — this is the central object of estimation theory.

The definition correctly carves the estimator as a rule mapping samples of observed data (random variables) to estimates of unknown parameters or functionals of the data-generating distribution. It distinguishes point estimators from interval estimators, names key properties (bias, consistency, efficiency, sufficiency), and specifies the persistence mechanism via mathematical characterization. Well-carved.

statistical-divergence scope correctly defines a human-made mathematical framework (functions D[P||Q]) for comparing probability distributions. Clear parameters, clear persistence mechanism. Well-carved.

f-divergence scope precisely defines a specific family of statistical divergences parameterized by a convex function f. Well-defined, specific, and clearly human-made mathematical construct. Includes KL-divergence, Hellinger distance as instances.
f-divergence IS a kind of statistical-divergence. The direction is correct (specific→general) and f-divergence files against its nearest kind. Note correctly identifies the inheritance relationship.

state-space-model scope correctly defines a mathematical representation using first-order equations relating state variables, inputs, outputs. Parameters and mechanism clearly stated. Standard concept, well-filed.

Definition correctly carves the state-space model: parameters (state vector x, input vector u, output y), persistence mechanism (first-order evolution equations), and includes both continuous (ẋ=f(x,u,t)) and discrete forms. Proper CARVE.

Definition correctly carves statistical divergence: parameters (two probability distributions P, Q), persistence mechanism (non-negative function D[P||Q] with D=0 iff P=Q), and specifies the mathematical object. Proper CARVE.

Definition correctly carves f-divergence: parameters (convex function f, distributions P and Q), persistence mechanism (expectation E_Q[f(dP/dQ)]), and specifies the mathematical object. Proper CARVE. Builds correctly on statistical-divergence.

Pinned sense is an identity claim, not a removal test: 'conjecture's identity is constitutively dependent on having the concept of proposition' is the Law 2b/8b pattern — every entry's identity rests on prior concepts, and that files nothing. The note's own math does not support the arrow: differential entropy h = -integral f(x) log f(x) dx integrates the log of the probability density (log-density), not the log-likelihood — the log of the probability of observed data given parameters is a different quantity with a different role (scoring a model, not measuring distribution spread). Remove the log-likelihood construct and differential entropy still operates exactly as defined. The note also garbles its target ('both differential entropy and log-likelihood itself operate on'), which reads like the pairing was not actually tested. No removal consequence shown = no DEPENDS_ON (Laws 2b, 8b).

Textbook instance relation, pinned sense matches: an f-divergence D_f[P||Q] = E_Q[f(dP/dQ)] with convex f is by construction a member of the family of statistical divergences — every f-divergence is one, and statistical-divergence is the nearest general kind (not a leap past an intermediate rung: there is no 'family-of-divergences' node between them). The note states the inclusion and a competent-speaker classification test, both of which hold.

Sense mismatch against the target's accepted definition (Law 11d). symbolic-system's accepted definition makes BOTH a finite inventory AND 'rules for combining those symbols into well-formed expressions' constitutive parameters.
